verdict.rationale: Batch calls explicitly support bulk operations by uploading a CSV list of recipients to run high-volume call campaigns, and this is complemented by a CLI/API/MCP server for programmatic bulk management of pathways, agents, and calls. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of batch-call scale limits or performance, and no evidence of bulk operations beyond calls (e.g., bulk pathway edits or bulk data export).
